format: math-web-html
math-web:
  macros:
    - math-core.sty

    textsc: mathrm

These examples import the repository-owned notation fixtures. The explicit `mathds: mathbf`
mapping chooses a bold indicator symbol in place of the LaTeX `dsfont` glyph.
The explicit `textsc: mathrm` mapping renders `\opt` as upright “Opt” without
small caps. The mapping arrow is defined in `math-core.sty`.

## Delimiters and vectors

$$\parens{x} \qquad \parens*{\frac{x}{2}} \qquad \parens[\Big]{x}$$

$$\set*{x\in\R}{x>0} \qquad \ang{\vv x,\vv y}$$

$$\norm[\Big]{\vv x} + \abs*{\frac{x}{2}} + \ceil{x} + \floor{x}$$

## Number sets and probability

$$\N\subset\Z\subset\Q\subset\R\subset\C$$

$$\Pr(A) \defeq \E\bracks{\1_A}$$

$$\Var(X) \qquad \Cov(X,Y) \qquad \Corr(X,Y)$$

$$X_n\convd X \qquad X_n\convp X \qquad X_n\convas X$$

## Analysis

$$\inner{u}{v}_H \qquad \inner*{\frac{u}{2}}{v}_H \qquad \inner[\Big]{u}{v}_H$$

$$\Lp{p}\!\parens*{\Omega} \qquad \norm[\Big]{f}_p$$

## Optimization and complexity

$$\opt \qquad \conv(S) \qquad \cone(S) \qquad \aff(S) \qquad \base$$

$$\OO{n\log n} \qquad \poly(n) \qquad \polytime$$

## Padded mapping arrow

$$x\fmapsto[\text{below}]{\text{above}}f(x)$$
